# Bundled espflash

The Windows executable in `windows-x64/` is the official `espflash` v4.5.0
release for `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`.

Source: <https://github.com/esp-rs/espflash/releases/tag/v4.5.0>

The downloaded release archive was verified with SHA-256:

`854c82c947c20e7f337f120f0398042ed1760f2269cb0f9be3d2beae3b66fbfb`

The executable is distributed under the terms in `windows-x64/LICENSE-MIT`
and `windows-x64/LICENSE-APACHE`.
